about.headline: Interfaces with clarity.
about.intro: I’m a front-end developer and web designer based in Brazil. I turn product requirements into clear, reusable interfaces with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, React and Next.js.
about.product: I created NocturnShop, my own SaaS product. My hands-on work covers landing pages, dashboards, marketplace interfaces and responsive web applications, connecting the interface to APIs, authentication, data, payments and automations.
about.approach: I focus on mobile-first design, reusable components, performance, technical SEO and accessibility. I’m available for freelance projects and development opportunities, from a focused landing page to an interactive web application.
about.deliveriesDetail: Pages, components, sections and product iterations.
about.integrationsDetail: APIs, authentication, data, payments and automations.
about.learningDetail: Web development, JavaScript, React, Git and architecture.
about.work: Landing pages, business websites, dashboards and responsive web applications.

project.a-casa-da-meia-noite.title: A Casa da Meia-Noite — Interactive Mystery
project.a-casa-da-meia-noite.description: An illustrated mystery game with explorable rooms, three clues and a secret ending. I built character encounters, a creature quiz and browser-saved progress, with responsive layouts, SVG cobwebs and scroll animations.
project.ecos-da-terra-media.title: Ecos da Terra-média — Interactive 3D Journey
project.ecos-da-terra-media.description: A fan-made Lord of the Rings experience with a 3D ring that moves through the page as you scroll. Includes a Middle-earth map, characters, creatures and an affinity quiz, with responsive imagery and on-demand rendering.
project.iridescencia.title: Iridescência — 3D Entomology Atlas
project.iridescencia.description: An interactive scientific-plate concept featuring an iridescent 3D butterfly. Visitors can rotate and zoom the specimen, switch views and explore its structure and field notes as the light changes.
project.flor-surreal.title: Flor Surreal — Speculative 3D Botany
project.flor-surreal.description: An artistic botanical-plate concept with a translucent 3D flower, shifting rainbow reflections and a soft halo. Interactive inspection, delicate veins and scientific notes sit within a responsive editorial layout.
project.forza-horizon-start.title: Forza Horizon Start Screen — React Game UI
project.forza-horizon-start.description: A racing-game start-screen concept with a neon sky, a perspective road, silhouetted cars and a festival atmosphere. A study in game interface composition built with React and CSS.
project.glass-effect-threejs.title: Glass Effect from ThreeJS — Interactive Interface
project.glass-effect-threejs.description: A dashboard-style visual experiment with cursor-responsive glass panels, soft highlights and layered depth. I explored an interactive glass effect and the interface around it.
project.portal-dimensional.title: Portal Dimensional — Canvas & GSAP Experience
project.portal-dimensional.description: A single-page visual experiment built around a neon portal, animated rings and Canvas particles. A GSAP timeline coordinates the cinematic presentation.
project.coffee-dashboard.title: Barista One — Coffee Dashboard Concept
project.coffee-dashboard.description: A coffee-themed SaaS dashboard concept using mock data. Reusable components, visual hierarchy and glass effects demonstrate an approach to presenting business information.
project.interactive-garden.title: Interactive Garden — Next.js Flowers
project.interactive-garden.description: An interactive garden where each click plants a different flower. Built with Next.js, SVG stems, CSS animation and a subtle wind effect.
project.balduino.title: Balduíno IV — Editorial Poster
project.balduino.description: An editorial web experiment inspired by historical posters. Large-scale typography and a dramatic atmosphere explore how layout and art direction can tell a story.
project.monarch.title: The Blood Crowned Monarch
project.monarch.description: A dark-fantasy landing-page concept combining cinematic art direction, subtle effects and visual storytelling.
project.dream-house.title: Dream House — Real Estate Landing Page
project.dream-house.description: A real-estate landing-page concept with editorial composition, refined typography and restrained decorative elements. A study in presenting property content through a clear visual narrative.
project.pingu.title: The Penguin and the Mountain — Meme Experiment
project.pingu.description: A visual storytelling experiment inspired by an existential meme, combining humor, atmosphere and art direction.
project.chess3d.title: 3D Chess — Cinematic Experience
project.chess3d.description: A contemplative WebGL chess scene with dramatic lighting and a composition inspired by the philosophy of the game.
project.surfer.title: Cosmic Drift — Silver Surfer Space Experience
project.surfer.description: A space-themed visual experiment exploring fluid motion, simulated depth and procedurally generated elements.
project.bdg3.title: Baldur’s Gate 3 — Interactive Cinematic Codex
project.bdg3.description: An arcane-grimoire interface concept with a dark atmosphere, narrative content and a data-driven structure.
project.jojo.title: JoJo — Interactive Cinematic Experience
project.jojo.description: A JoJo-inspired visual experiment with immersive navigation, changing atmospheres and a distinct visual identity.
project.neuroflow-ai.title: NeuroFlow AI — Next.js SaaS Landing Page
project.neuroflow-ai.description: A SaaS landing-page concept built with Next.js. The project explores reusable components, clear page structure and coordinated transitions.
project.bedroom-aparts.title: Bedroom Aparts — React Real Estate Dashboard
project.bedroom-aparts.description: A real-estate dashboard concept with data visualization, glass effects and microinteractions, built with React and Motion.
project.cars.title: Karzone Luxury Automotive — Digital Showcase
project.cars.description: An automotive landing-page concept with visual storytelling, scroll-based transitions and an interactive vehicle showcase.
project.vantage.title: Vantage Expedition — Cinematic Web Experience
project.vantage.description: An alpine-exploration concept combining an editorial interface, expanding cards and an immersive visual atmosphere.
project.nocturngear.title: NocturnGear — Outdoor E-commerce Interface
project.nocturngear.description: An outdoor retail interface concept with an interactive product grid and a visual identity shaped around the outdoor setting.
project.nike.title: Nike 3D Product Experience — Interactive Showcase
project.nike.description: A WebGL product showcase with dynamic rotation and guided scrolling, placing the shoe at the center of the experience.
project.pagani.title: Pagani Digital Showroom — 3D Web Experience
project.pagani.description: A digital automotive showroom concept with cinematic lighting and real-time 3D rendering.
project.neo-street.title: Neo-Street — Futuristic Streetwear Interface
project.neo-street.description: An experimental streetwear concept exploring a digital urban identity through striking layouts and product grids.
project.cinematic-portifolio.title: Portfolio Scene — Interactive Cinematic Hero
project.cinematic-portifolio.description: A portfolio-opening experiment with large-scale typography, mouse parallax and layered cards that simulate 3D depth.
project.dark-fantasy.title: Dark Fantasy Living Wallpaper — 3D Experience
project.dark-fantasy.description: An experimental living-wallpaper concept with a central 3D model, a luminous halo, particles and butterflies in a real-time dark-fantasy scene.
project.eterna-design.title: Eterna — Interactive Sci-Fi Editorial Poster
project.eterna-design.description: A React experiment combining minimalist sci-fi art direction, animated typography, cursor-responsive light and layered parallax. Letter distortion and small interface details shape the opening scene.
project.bem-vindo-ha-terra.title: Portal Terra — Welcome to Earth
project.bem-vindo-ha-terra.description: A humorous sci-fi landing-page experiment presented as a diplomatic portal for visiting aliens. Background video and a cinematic interface support the story.
project.noccheckbox.title: Noc Checkbox — Analytics Dashboard
project.noccheckbox.description: An analytics dashboard concept combining charts, glass effects and microinteractions in a sci-fi-inspired interface. The focus is making complex information easier to scan.
project.whatsapp-api.title: Conduit API — WhatsApp Link Generator
project.whatsapp-api.description: A SaaS landing page for a WhatsApp link generator, exploring a focused user journey, microinteractions and a WhatsApp-inspired visual identity.
project.yamara.title: Yamara — Motorcycle Showcase
project.yamara.description: An automotive concept for the fictional Yamara brand, with a cinematic opening, scroll-based model presentation and interface microinteractions.
project.steel-ball-run.title: Steel Ball Run — Interactive Cinematic Experience
project.steel-ball-run.description: A visual tribute inspired by JoJo: Steel Ball Run, with scroll-based storytelling, dramatic transitions and an atmosphere shaped around each character.
project.diepio.title: Diepio Clone — TypeScript Arcade Shooter
project.diepio.description: A browser game inspired by diep.io, built around 2D Canvas combat, XP progression, leveling and tank upgrades.
project.login-1.title: Calm Access Login — Next.js 15 Interface
project.login-1.description: A login interface with local validation, password visibility controls, a strength indicator, Caps Lock feedback, a recovery view and a demo account for testing.
project.pedra-branca.title: White Stone — Interactive Spiritual Experience
project.pedra-branca.description: An interactive visual experience inspired by the symbolism of the white stone in Revelation 2:17.
project.elden-editorial.title: Elden Ring — Interactive Editorial Experience
project.elden-editorial.description: An independent frontend experiment built with React, TypeScript, Vite and Framer Motion, translating Elden Ring’s dark atmosphere into an interactive editorial presentation.
project.emmersia.title: Immersia — Technology Activation Landing Page
project.emmersia.description: A concept landing page with a technology-focused visual identity and coordinated animation, exploring brand presentation, usability and performance.
project.login-lamp.title: Login Lamp — Interactive Login Interface
project.login-lamp.description: A React login interface with a lamp beside the form. Pulling its cord turns the light on and off, changing the atmosphere around the authentication flow.
project.nubank.title: Nubank Concept — Financial Brand Landing Page
project.nubank.description: An independent Nubank-inspired concept with a cinematic hero centered on the Ultravioleta card. Visual storytelling and animation explore brand presentation and trust.
project.sistema-solar.title: Solar System — Interactive Web Experience
project.sistema-solar.description: An interactive application for exploring the eight planets. Navigation updates the interface colors, background and information panels to reflect the selected planet.
project.pintura-digital.title: Digital Painting in React — Interactive Illustration
project.pintura-digital.description: A React visual experiment that builds a digital painting in layers, combining illustrated elements, an artistic composition and subtle animation.
project.palavras-particulas.title: Words into Particles — Interactive Canvas Experiment
project.palavras-particulas.description: A Canvas experiment that turns typed text into interactive particles. They react to the mouse and smoothly return to the original letter shapes.
project.x1animes.title: Anime X1 — Table of Fates
project.x1animes.description: An anime battle simulator with character cards, rankings, filters, a chaos mode and narrative outcomes. Its logic considers attributes, abilities, weaknesses and counters.
project.relogio-analogico.title: Analog Clock — Visual Experience
project.relogio-analogico.description: A full-screen analog clock with detailed markings, moving hands and a dark responsive interface, exploring light and simulated depth.
